card.name: Space before patient counts in trials
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number giving a patient count or denominator, such as after 'in 15 of' or 'of the'. It appears in clinical trial results and adverse event tables.

modes.label: Before denominator
modes.description: The gap after 'of' or 'of the' just before the total number of patients.
modes.example: Adrenal insufficiency resolved in 17% of the<< >>6 patients.

modes.label: In table rows
modes.description: A space between a table label and the n/N counts that follow.

card.writes: It seems to push toward Chinese and odd word-start pieces, with no clear link to medical output.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a patient count number in trial results.
